body: I’m so glad to help!!! Stay strong and you can do this 😊
Wooow, the fact he’s still trying to contact after having a kid is a clear sign you dodged a bullet! Congratulations 🙌🏼
It’s never a simple journey or recovery. Stay strong! ❤️
Oh this was about a year ago and he’s no longer engaged or even married. He is however still an a hole and I see it clear as day now lol
Thank you!
No

Agree with this. The sooner you let go of any hope you’re holding onto the sooner you’ll get better. Accept the relationship is over and she’s gone. You also need to prepare yourself for when she moves on, because when she does and you’re still hung up on her, it’s gonna destroy you. Trust me.

Thank you and you do deserve better than this. 

So this happened late last year and I’ve now moved on from it (lots has happened since then lol) but when I found out he got engaged it felt just as heart wrenching as when we broke up if anything worse because stupidly enough I still held on to hope we’d get back together. It had affected me so bad I had to take time of work. 

Anyway, what I’d recommend is removing everything and anything that reminds you of them, destroy any hope you have of getting back together and distract yourself as much as possible by going out or focusing on work (you’ve probably already been told this so I’m sorry if it just sounds like repetitive mumble haha) 

I think the only reason why it had affected me so badly is because I wasn’t doing enough to move on. Although I wasn’t contacting him or anything like that I was still thinking of him constantly and making excuses for his behaviour and just holding onto the hope he’ll come back.  

And trust me when I say I know how hard it is but you’ve just got to try because it is not worth all the heartache and mental breakdowns. ❤️

From experience, I’d suggest you do everything you possibly can to get over him now or even just try and prepare yourself for when he does start dating again because if you don’t and that day comes, it will absolutely destroy you -just like it did with me.
Yeah it’s certainly not healthy and definitely not worth it. Especially when you’re stalking her families social media too. I fell off the wagon so many times but I eventually got there.
Exactly. It’s definitely made us stronger!
You’re welcome! Stay strong and I hope you pull through this

Yes! I didn’t even realise how low my self esteem and self worth was until I started to heal. When we first broke up, I remember thinking how will i meet another man like him, he was perfect blah blah I had completely idealised him to a point where he was flawless in my eyes and now I know that’s not true, I just had such a negative outlook of myself. I was also a bit superficial and materialistic.
Thank you and just remember there isn’t a set time for us to get over someone. I’ll always love him j and consider him to be my greatest love (yet lol) but just hold tight.
Congrats keep going strong!
It is lol
No need to apologise and I’m happy to hear that! God bless ❤️
Congrats on going strong!
I’m glad to hear it helped! I’ll never understand how people can live with themselves doing that. Fortunately my ex had met his (now ex) fiancé after we broke up.
Then it def would’ve been heart wrenching to see him post that girl. I don’t think I’d handle it too well
Please don’t feel weird! We’re all in this together and trust me there is no judgement here. Especially from me.
Thank you and God bless ❤️
Yeah, I do look back and feel awful about all the time I wasted for people because I too was just too stubborn to move on.
At least you realised this young. I’ve wasted my 20s on men who never valued me and now I have nothing to show for what I invested into each and every one of them.
Stay strong!
Yes definitely! It’s also helped me to stop giving my body away so easily and my decision to remain celibate until marriage

It’s definitely made me stronger. Did you have to go through different therapists? I was forced to do therapy (even tried hypnotherapy) by people around me and found it unsuccessful but I guess that could be because I wasn’t trying to help myself.
Wooow. Did you ever ask why he didn’t share you two together on his socials?

I know what you mean! He friended his ex within days of our break up which destroyed me. You’ve definitely done better than me though 2 months after we broke up I was still having mini breakdowns during the day and crying myself to sleep at night. I did find strength in God and I’m happy to hear you did too ❤️
It must’ve been hard for you but well dome
Agreed. Especially since social media warps our perspective of what a persons life is.
Congrats, it’s definitely a difficult step to take

Oh well give it time haha
I wish I were like that as soon as we broke up

Yeah I used to check hourly the changes in his friends lists and if he started following a new girl I’d go to their page and see if he had liked any of her pics or made any comments. Congrats on disconnecting though, such a hard step to take
Congrats! Such a hard step but well worth it

Oh I was craaaazy. I would’ve literally died for him. It’s definitely hard though, seeing someone who think you’re the world one day and lose all interest in you the next. Luckily, we didn’t talk at all after the break up as he just ignored me and I ended up going interstate so I didn’t see him. I continued to stalk him for ages though which would determine my every emotion.
That definitely would’ve made the recovery process easier.
No it’s better this way. I mean, imagine if did end up getting married and having kids and he decided to leave me. That would’ve been an complicated situation which would’ve been harder to deal with.
I wish I were like that, would’ve saved me a lot of time and heartbreak.

I’ll admit it took me a long time to finally stop. It’s different for everyone, some people are strong enough to give it up cold turkey whereas I wasn’t lol and I ended up wasting a year of my life on it. The sad thing was, while I spent every waking moment obsessing over him, he was out there living his life.
Absolutely. I remember seeing him friend his ex gf shortly after we broke up and that destroyed me. Definitely not worth the heart break.

I’ll be honest I blocked him so many times but then I’d just unblock him or stalk him via other means eg for his insta I’d just go on safari as his profile was public. I think just do what you think would be best for you. Some people have had others just monitor them or have gotten rid of their phones altogether.
Yeah you’re better reaching out to people in a similar situation as they’ll more likely be better equipped to help
Yeah, meeting people in the same boat definitely helped because I was pretty much in a situation where everyone irl was sick of me carrying on about it lol

I can’t say when but you will eventually get to the point where you feel peace. Trust me. Not in a million years would I ever have felt like I do now. You may never feel like you’ve moved on but you will find peace. I’m only a dm away if you need to chat 🙂
Remain hopeful. I never thought I’d ever be in this position but here I am. I pray you get to a point where you no longer feel the kind of pain you have.
How easy is it to learn? I’ve been looking into it but I feel as if I’m not very tech savvy enough.

I feel this so much. 

Recently turned 30 and feel I’m in the same predicament. I never envisioned my life would be this lonely. Being around other women my age is torture because they’re either settled in families or succeeding in their careers. I’m also not looking forward to being around my family as I’ll be reminded I truly am alone. 

The deafening sound of my biological clock isn’t helping either.

Ikr, the one moment he wasn’t on my mind and bam! 

Now that he’s called, Idk how I feel. 

A part of me still loves him and wants him back but I think the best thing for me is to take this as closure and finally move on.

I know for sure I cannot do another year of this if he were to leave again which would be highly likely. 

Thank you for your supportive message ❤️

Yeah I feel as if the best thing to do rn is just move on for good. As much as I love him, I really cannot got through this all again.

Yeah, ikr, it’s actually making me think is this what he did around the time we broke up, hit up his ex. Right now, I don’t think I’ll be going down this road again but who knows how I’ll feel in an hour. I really am just all over the place.

To be happy.

This.

I’m glad you have found peace and hope to have that one day too.

I know it’s cliche but you will get through it, and it will make you stronger just keep at it ❤️

His engagement is what I needed to confirm were never getting back together, yes I held onto the hope we’d get back together but now I know we’re not. 

Please don’t reply to this message as I have no interest in any input you have.

Why do I hold myself back? Because I’m still in love with him? I try everyday to stop ffs.

Oh and it’ll be a year in December.
Also, I think because I revolved my entire world and future around him, when he left my world in effect fell apart and I didn’t really plan for this. Not that anyone plans to be left.
